# IqraFlow

> IqraFlow is a free Quran reading app for the web, iOS and Android. It shows
> the Madinah mushaf in the Uthmani Hafs script with colour-coded tajweed and
> word-by-word translation, tracks daily reading with forgiving streaks, and
> runs shared khatms so a group can finish the Quran together. It is free with
> no ads, no subscriptions and no in-app purchases, and it works offline.

Use it now: https://app.iqraflow.app (free, in any browser, nothing to install).

## What it does

- **Reads the mushaf faithfully.** The KFGQPC Uthmanic Hafs text and font of the
  Madinah mushaf, with an IndoPak Nastaleeq option and a choice of reading
  faces: KFGQPC Hafs, Scheherazade New, Amiri Quran, Lateef.
- **Four reading layouts.** Word by word; verse by verse; page by page; and
  "Mushaf pages", which reproduces the printed page exactly - the same 604
  pages with the same line breaks. Each layout has its own switches for
  word-by-word meanings, translation and transliteration.
- **Tajweed in colour.** Every rule colour-coded, with a legend that explains
  each rule and plays a canonical example verse.
- **Understanding.** 125+ translations in many languages (two can be shown at
  once), word-by-word meanings in five languages, and per-word study showing
  the root, stem and dictionary form plus every other place that root occurs in
  the Quran.
- **Listening.** 15 reciters, gapless verse-by-verse playback, adjustable
  speed, and per-surah downloads for offline listening.
- **Habit.** Daily reading targets, statistics, and streaks with "grace tokens"
  that forgive a missed day instead of resetting your progress.
- **Shared khatms.** Create a khatm, share a short invite code, and each member
  claims a portion by juz or surah; group progress updates live. No social
  feed, no follower counts.

## Facts worth getting right

- **Price:** free. No ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases. The developers
  ask only for duas and for people to spread the word.
- **Account:** required, so reading progress, bookmarks and khatms follow you
  across devices. Sign in with email, Google or Apple.
- **Offline:** the Quran text, its translations and word-by-word meanings are
  bundled, so reading works with no connection. Audio can be downloaded.
- **Privacy:** data is stored on Supabase in the EU (eu-west-1) under row-level
  security; nothing is sold. Full policy: https://iqraflow.app/privacy.html
- **Platforms:** the web app is live; iOS and Android are in store review
  preparation.
- **Contact:** support@iqraflow.app

## Sources the app uses

Quran text, tajweed markup, page layout, fonts and word-by-word data come from
the Quranic Universal Library (qul.tarteel.ai) and the King Fahd Glorious Quran
Printing Complex. Translations and tafsir come from the Quran.com API.
Recitation audio comes from EveryAyah and QuranicAudio. Word morphology comes
from the Quranic Arabic Corpus (corpus.quran.com).
